source_decisions.source_disposition: The period validator always writes allowing returns, including empty/error; selected callers also differ in whether they invoke it. P3-001 remains open, not a new result.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Do not infer actual accounting-period acceptance from dead rejection UI, or call a Print route fully unvalidated when its own checks exist.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Common.AllowEdit fail-open, default-allowed FormPermission and different button classifiers are distinct from a resource-aware command decision. Read all16 local allowEdit/electronic flag writes and their whole containing bodies; contract allowEdit only initializes true.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Electronic policy can independently block Contract; POS/Sale have status/ProcType exceptions; one Home POS opener tests IsEnabled. No blanket all-permissions-absent or deployed unauthorized-save assertion.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Save checks period helper and parsed txtNet > 0 except InvType9. SavePrint instead checks previous return with the same key twice; public PayBill consumes PayInvoice bool. They do not share one validator. Explicit null skips EntryOper and the central null branch commits the invoice. Do not call that a failed BindToEntry here: no entry was requested in this parent. Inventory.UpdateItemStock runs before SaveInvoice and has no reversal on saved=false in this body. This is loaded ItemsStock DataTable cache mutation, not a SQL stock commit. Log, print and sync are saved-guarded, then false returns before cost/message/CLR. Sync bool is awaited but not tested; async void returns no save outcome to the entry command.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Public PayInvoice true is a payment-dialog result, not SaveInvoice success; no all-route safety or SQL stock-loss claim.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Ordinary Save uses CheckProiedAcc, reference warning, parsed positive net except type9, confirmation and supplier. SavePrint uses nonempty/nonzero parent net, positive quantities and supplier, but no same period/reference/confirmation branch (P4-031). Counterexample to blanket null acceptance: for ProcType1/2 and InvType1/22, BindToEntry null immediately returns before cache/save. Other types may intentionally pass null. Cache mutation is before local save even in this parent that checks null entry; saved=false does not undo that cache delta. Print sets Invoic.ISNew=false before awaited SyncInvoice, so the later sync receives that flag; wasNew is separately kept for message/log. Broker is saved-guarded, unlike transfer. No remote wrapper bool is consumed.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Purchase rejects null entry for selected financial variants, contrasting other editors. Print quantity guards are real. Neither makes separate transactions atomic.

source_decisions.source_disposition: F6 uses btnPay period/employee/customer/items/quantity and status-specific electronic/edit guards. Public PayBill checks a different edit/payment exception; F7 Hold checks items/slot but skips btnPay validation and sets ProcType3. Unlike the other editors, a false local save returns before UpdateItemStock; successful cache changes are limited to ProcType1/2. Independent entry transaction and optional cloud-first precede invoice completion; table/order helpers use separate local calls, catch and do not join the header transaction. updat_table/Insert_Table_Order/Update_Table_Order and RptPrint_Tables call occur before if(!saved)return; Hold publishes HoldList and button state after a void SaveAndPrint call. Empty BackgroundWorker1_DoWork is not a sync execution.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Status/ProcType guards and stock-after-false-return are counterexamples. Hold slot full produces no save. No exact async schedule or remote durability claim.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Save and SavePrint call the period helper; F6 calls ValidateInvoice directly. Validator checks return linkage, items, quantities, required salesman, confirmation, trial, net and credit client; its body contains no period call. SaveAndPrint edit guard applies to nonnew ProcType1/2 only outside the payment-status/not-updated exception, then electronic/allowEdit flags. This is not a universal save or document ACL. Log/print/sync/message are saved-guarded; successful print path sets ISNew=false before SyncInvoice. Quotation restores ProcType1 and CLR after calling void ValidateInvoice, including a synchronous validation rejection.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: P7-162 remains written event duplication; quotation void rejection/reset is a separate unnumbered question. No executed duplicate posting or CLR alias claim.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Save calls period helper; SavePrint skips it and calls ValidateInvoice with item/quantity/salesman/confirmation/trial/net/client checks. The latter still performs meaningful checks; not a no-validation route. Constructor initializes allowEditInvoice=true; selected full-file flag-write census finds no later local write, and ConfigurePermissions only adjusts date/delete UI. Electronic invoice policy is independently loaded and can still block edits. InvoiceOperContract.SaveInvoice writes InvContratct and contract lines. Header SQL bridge shows all four allegedly missing tax parameters ARE added before ExecuteNonQuery; reject that proposed defect. The saved/IsPrinted/PrintNo branch only sets ISNew=false: no RptPrint call exists in SaveAndPrint. Sync bool is ignored. Message and CLR remain saved-guarded; cache does not.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Four tax header parameters are present, refuting suggested omission. Guarded electronic edits still reject; print-call absence is not swallowed printer outcome.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Save applies period helper then ProcType1 Receive / ProcType2 Send. SavePrint dispatches new ProcType2 to Receive, otherwise tab0 directly calls SaveAndPrint without the ordinary period branch. SaveSend and SaveReceive each invoke async-void SaveAndPrint twice. Send mutates to incoming/new, recalculates cost and shows success without a returned bool from either call (P4-019). Cache changes before branch rewrite and local SaveInvoice; two parent invocations can each mutate the loaded cache. No SQL stock result is executed or certified. Log/print/sync are saved-guarded but broker/offline section only checks Home._is_active, not saved. Success dialog in Send cannot establish two durable saves.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Source-store branch calculation/fallback1 is not document authorization; two void calls may perform synchronous work before returning. No invented timing or persistent stock result.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Both mapping bodies mutate parent IDs/numbers, copy header/collection properties, build Items projection and invoke local composite writer; VerifyIsNewInvoice has no true assignment in the read body. These are local facts, not a missing-model substitute.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Property setter copy/reference behavior and model enum semantics are not established by assignment syntax. No universal cloning, financial-formula or deep-alias certification.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Both BindToEntry bodies catch to null; central writers permit Entr==null and otherwise call EntryOper.SaveEnty with a new connection/transaction before parent commit. Full SaveEnty has no local empty/balance/period check. P3-003/P3-002 qualified.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Purchase explicitly returns on null for its financial variants; IO/Transfer intentionally pass null. Do not conflate all nulls or certify model/accounting invariants from syntax.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Read helper mutates loaded ItemsStock rows by ItemId first match, then store check and PrimaryQnty delta; catches write debug. IO/Purchase/Transfer pre-save, Sale/Contract outside saved, POS saved success ProcType1/2 only.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: This is in-memory DataTable cache consistency, not a SQL persistent-stock update or observed business loss. No prior-edit reverse delta is in this body, but not all event/reload owners are closed.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Print/sync/broker/table/cache/messages have different saved guards. Attachment helpers use File.Copy and separate connections; ordinary encoded helper owns a connection while contract encoded SQL is inside parent. Sync noncloud posts/marks then returns default false; contract noncloud marks ordinary Inv.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: P6-007 same-root ordinary ordering; remaining broker/remote/provider/helper contracts are not run or all reviewed. No end-to-end health from bool, log, green UI or thread scheduling.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Whole central writers check employee/store/treasury/payment/customer/trial and key header updates by InvGlobalID; they receive no period/form permission/original connection/allowed-set parameter. Payload Branch set/update is not branch ownership authorization. Contract normal and empty-line fallback targets differ.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: No claim deployed constraints or grants are absent, global keys collide, or any user accessed a forbidden invoice. RptInventory global-key reopen is a counterexample to blanket local-id claim. Header parameters are present, not missing-four.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Individually assessed21 Home factories, GenerateInvoice, three RptInventory helpers and contract detail opener. Name/Tag/lookup timing and type/proc/entry configurations differ; global-key reopens differ from old local-id routes. Contract detail sets UI InvType2 while query row type23.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: 26 selected opener OWNERS and31 creation expressions are not26 capability assessments, not all repository factories, and not WPF Loaded schedule proof. Receiver guards remain; type/policy questions stay unnumbered.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Four whole public imports call void SearchByID, then overwrite first matching ItemId price/quantity and recalculate/bind. GenerateInvoice can import into first open POS without a new window. No explicit inserted/merged/cancelled result is consumed.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: P7-144 is contract/last-match and not automatically the same root. SearchByID/ItemOper and itemList producers remain readable-local obligations; no null/deep-copy/unit/financial-outcome assumptions.
